# Tobkiri Cursor Studio renderer

`config.js`, `motions.js`, and `engine.js` are source snapshots from
https://github.com/harupipipipi/tobkiri-computer-use/tree/60c8f1a3cd9e4d92a38e466b7fc7bc432de913e1/companion/src
(Tobkiri Computer Use PR #2). They contain the same cursor/character appearance.

Browser Use builds its own extension-local renderer from these versioned sources
with `scripts/sync-cursor.mjs`. It does not load the Computer repository, start a
Computer process, or require Cursor Studio. Generated `character-runtime.mjs` is
ignored and regenerated by setup/MCP/test entry points.

Copyright remains with the original Tobkiri authors. The sources are distributed
under this repository's MIT license; no third-party package is bundled here.
